basis: The registered 16–18 bin has useful same-frame and archived external Gaia geometry. The two registered color cells have positive QRF minus nominal signed Gaia score in the application draw and 980 and 1,340 high-S/N geometry references over the full magnitude envelope. Weak detected W1 has no application geometry reference; retain the contaminated or unavailable state 2 and significant state 4 with their distinct band masks.
purpose: Assess the joint support for a magnitude-limited near-dwarf candidate catalog.
